questions.question: From the subject survey, Maths 11, English 7, Natural Sciences 9, Life Skills 6 and Social Sciences 3, find the most and least popular subjects and how many more chose Maths than English.
questions.expected_answer: Maths is most popular with 11 and Social Sciences least with 3. 11 minus 7 is 4, so 4 more learners chose Maths than English.

questions.question: Write a short summary of the tuck shop sales: 24, 18, 20, 16 and 34 vetkoek from Monday to Friday.
questions.expected_answer: The tuck shop sold 112 vetkoek from Monday to Friday. Friday was the busiest day with 34 and Thursday the quietest with 16. Friday sold more than double Thursday's sales.

questions.question: Make a prediction about next Friday's sales and explain why it is not certain.
questions.expected_answer: Next Friday will probably be the busiest day again, with about 30 to 35 vetkoek sold, because Friday was busiest this week. It is not certain because things can change, such as rain or a school trip, and one week is only a small amount of data.
